response.consequence: The UI shows edit and delete actions on federated rules that the ruler API rejects or that should be read-only. This is a regression from the previous behaviour.
response.explanation: useAllAlertRuleAbilities used to compute isFederated with isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group). The change makes it delegate to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated = false (the check is commented out as a TODO). A CombinedRule in a federated external ruler group (for example a Mimir federated group) is therefore no longer treated as immutable. Update, Delete, Pause and Restore are now reported as supported where they were NotSupported. isFederatedRuleGroup still exists in utils/rules.ts, and other callers such as RulesGroup and RuleDetailsButtons still use it, so the old behaviour is intended.
response.title: Federated rule group check dropped from useAllAlertRuleAbilities

response.consequence: In the list view, users cannot pause or delete Grafana rules from the actions menu. The Silence entry appears but does nothing. Recording rules lose Pause and Export. This is a functional regression with no authorization bypass.
response.explanation: The change makes AlertRuleMenu compute canPause, canDelete and canSilence from the Grafana prom-rule abilities, so they can be true when rulerRule is undefined, which is the case in the new list view where the ruler request was removed. The rendering code was not updated. The Pause item requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) (lines 123-125), and the Delete item requires rulerRule (line 165). In RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx the SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer only renders when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true (line 104), and rule is undefined in the list view. So Pause and Delete never appear in the list. "Silence notifications" is shown because canSilence is true, but clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer and no drawer renders. Separately, the prom ability set gates Pause, Restore, DeletePermanently and ModifyExport on isAlertingRule, whereas the old code allowed any Grafana-managed rule. Recording rules therefore lose Pause and Export.
response.title: List-view menu grants prom-rule abilities, but Pause/Delete/Silence actions still require a ruler rule

response.consequence: In the new list view and in the filter view, which now uses GrafanaRuleListItem, the Silence menu item for Grafana alerting rules is shown but does nothing when clicked.
response.explanation: The change makes `rule` optional, and GrafanaRuleListItem now renders `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} .../>` with no ruler rule. AlertRuleMenu computes `canSilence` from Grafana prom-rule abilities and shows the Silence item, which calls `handleSilence` and sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true. The drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, and `rule` is undefined in this case, so nothing appears.
